-46.52842,-23.64466.name: Huntington - Centro de Medicina Reprodutiva - Unidade Ibirapuera
-46.52842,-23.64466.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: https://www.huntington.com.br/. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

37.61730,55.75580.name: Federal Research Center for Animal Husbandry
37.61730,55.75580.desc: Russia’s principal livestock genetics institute. Russia bans the cultivation of engineered crops while importing engineered feed, and its editing research continues regardless of the cultivation ban — a combination that appears in no simple account of which countries are for or against.

-104.82100,38.83300.name: Nutrien Ag Solutions
-104.82100,38.83300.desc: The largest agricultural retail network in the world, selling seed, chemicals and agronomic advice directly to farmers across the Americas and Australia. This is where trait choice is actually presented to a grower, by a salesperson with an inventory, and no approval process examines that step.

0.10000,52.22000.name: NIAB
0.10000,52.22000.desc: A century-old British crop research organisation running industry-funded field trials: early plant breeding screens, disease assessment, agrochemical evaluation for the registration of new products, and demonstration plots for farmers. It states plainly that all such work is strictly confidential. That single condition is why the trial layer of this map is thin in Europe — the plots exist, the data exists, and a member of the public cannot see either, because the contract rather than the regulation determines what is published.

-2.75000,52.77000.name: Gemini Genetics
-2.75000,52.77000.desc: One of the United Kingdom's first animal tissue banks, founded in 2018, taking skin samples from dogs, cats and horses and culturing and cryopreserving them so the cells stay able to regenerate rather than merely intact. The cloning itself happens in Texas: samples are shipped to a US partner when an owner decides to proceed, with an option to hold material in both countries at once. That division of labour is the entry. The step that is time-critical and must happen near the animal — taking and culturing the tissue — is done locally and is not itself cloning; the regulated act happens on another continent. Its sister companies are a stallion insemination service and a kennel fertility clinic, and it also supports a conservation biobank on this map. Pet, livestock and endangered-species genetics run through one small Shropshire operation.

-2.75000,52.77000.name: Elite Kennel Fertility
-2.75000,52.77000.desc: A canine fertility clinic, and the sister company through which tissue reaches the tissue bank next door. Its own explanation of why tissue rather than sperm or eggs is the clearest statement of the technical case in this facet: semen freezing is widely available but only for entire males, egg freezing is limited, castrated animals are excluded altogether, and sex cells carry half the DNA of body cells. Skin tissue sidesteps all four constraints. That is why the pet cloning industry is built on tissue banks rather than on the reproductive services that came before it, and why a service sold as preservation is the necessary first half of a service sold as cloning.

117.20090,39.08420.name: Tianjin Ringpu Bio-Technology
117.20090,39.08420.desc: A major Chinese veterinary biologics manufacturer producing poultry and other livestock vaccines, investing in bioreactor capacity and quality systems with the stated ambition of competing internationally. It belongs on this map beside the European and American vectored-vaccine producers for one reason: poultry is where recombinant vector vaccines are used most heavily anywhere, China raises more poultry than any other country, and until this round the facet recorded only Western manufacturers. A picture of who administers engineered viruses to birds that omits the largest poultry sector on Earth is not a picture of the industry.
